title: Match HTML-to-PNG guide aspect ratio (1200x628) to both Web and LINE Flex hero
context_summary: Visual guides are displayed both inside Step 4 on /neurohands and as LINE Flex Card hero images.
observation: Using 16:10 with object-fit:cover clipped the left and right edges of 1200x628 visual guide text.
verified_action: Set web .guide-media to aspect-ratio 1200/628 with object-fit:contain and LINE Flex hero aspectRatio to 191:100.

title: Use transparent white+cyan RGBA PNG wordmark and Midnight Navy icon mark for seamless mobile dark-mode header sync
context_summary: Mobile screenshot on iOS Edge Dark Mode revealed a stark white JPEG box behind the NEUROHANDS logo inside the Midnight Navy header.
observation: Opaque white-background JPEGs cannot blend into dark brand headers and create harsh rectangular cutouts when mobile browsers apply dark themes.
verified_action: Embed transparent 480x78 RGBA PNG wordmark on transparent .logo, Midnight Navy 96x96 icon PNG for #favicon and .tour-mark, Midnight Navy pill for .flogo, theme-color #060D28, and solid #38BDF8 mobile hero em text.

title: Generate synchronized Midnight Navy LINE OA Profile Cover (1080x878) and Circular-Safe Avatar (640x640) served via /assets/brand
context_summary: LINE Official Account Profile (@865sirgf) still used legacy light-gray cover and white circular avatar, and LINE restricts OA profile/cover uploads to LINE Official Account Manager (no Messaging API endpoint).
observation: Keeping cover/avatar artwork out of version control or unhosted forces manual PC-to-phone file transfer and risks brand drift.
verified_action: Built scripts/generate-line-profile-assets.mjs to render 1080x878 cover (center safe-band) and 640x640 circle-safe avatar in Midnight Navy + Electric Cyan, added allowlisted GET /assets/brand/:file route and --check gate, and verified visually via line_oa_profile_preview.png.
